findings.description: List of findings to report. Each finding is an object with a required 'title' and optional 'severity' (info|low|medium|high|critical, default 'info'), 'category', 'file', 'line', and 'detail'.

title.description: Short one-line summary of the finding.

severity.description: Severity level. Defaults to 'info' when omitted or invalid.

file.description: Optional file path the finding relates to.

line.description: Optional line number in the file.

detail.description: Optional extended explanation of the finding.

title.description: Optional overall title for the findings report.

summary.description: Optional overall summary of the findings report.
